title: Save confirmations
summary: You now see a clear confirmation after every save, and a clear message when something needs fixing.
changes: Show a confirmation message just below the header after saving a profile, ticket, case, consultation, plugin settings or email template. It closes by itself after a few seconds, or you can dismiss it.
Show problems with a form in an error message that stays until you dismiss it.
Announce both messages to screen readers.
Confirm when a new case or consultation is created.
version_rationale: Patch: presentation and feedback only. Routes, permissions and stored data are unchanged.
validation: FlashToastTest for confirmation and error toasts, and status checks on case create and plugin settings save.
Toast JavaScript tests for auto-dismiss and announcement politeness.
Save, profile, settings, mail, case, consultation and layout test files locally, and the full PHPUnit suite in CI.
Manual check of a Profile save in the local preview.
known_limitations: Messages appear after the page reloads; there are no live notifications.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
